Frequently Asked Questions
Our company is visiting a large colleges for a campus drive. Can Xobin support large-scale concurrent test takers?
Yes. Xobin supports large-scale concurrent test takers and supports the hiring process with
structured assessments
, making recruitment hassle-free.
What types of applicant assessment tests does Xobin provide for campus hiring?
Xobin has a broad number of
assessments for several skills
. Also, we have a large number of questions. So, recruiters can use these questions to create customized assessments for the test.
How does Xobin help in campus placement?
Xobin is a virtual hiring tool that reduces the time involved in
campus hiring
while handling recruitments for humongous universities. It streamlines the hiring process with structured assessments, making recruitment hassle-free.
Do students need to register on Xobin or download any software before taking up their test?
No. Xobin is completely
cloud-based campus recruiting software tool
. Hence, students don’t need to install any software or download any files. Moreover, to minimize drop-off rates, test takers do not need to signup or register on Xobin. Our clients will send an assessment invite via email or a public URL to the test takers. Therefore, students can take up the test using the link they have received.
Does Xobin provide pre-screened candidates readily available for interviews?
No. Xobin is a platform to screen candidates. However, we don’t aggregate candidate data to be shared across multiple customers. Simply put, each test is linked to a specific company. As an
ISO and GDPR-compliant organization
, we do not use assessment data or sell candidate data. Therefore, we can’t share pre-screened candidates or scores with any other client. Details for the same are shared on our
privacy policy
